comparison.objective: Load an anesthetic cartridge into a dental syringe and set its harpoon.
comparison.physical_skill: Orientation-sensitive insertion, piston/harpoon engagement, force limitation, and precise rest placement.
comparison.success_condition: Cartridge correctly oriented and seated, harpoon passes aspiration test, syringe on rest, hands clear; stopper not overdriven.
comparison.reason: Tests delicate keyed loading and engagement rather than aperture-mediated material separation.
